about_the_game:
Embark on an interstellar journey in this fast-paced side-scrolling action game where destruction is your only path forward. You play as Ignis, a living ball of plasma, drifting through the infinite void of space, determined to reclaim the essence that was stolen from you. A powerful cosmic enemy has taken particles of your being, scattering fragments across the galaxy. To regain your strength, you must tear through waves of enemies, crush massive bosses, and gather back what is rightfully yours.

Every level takes you deeper into uncharted space, with planets, asteroids, and cosmic phenomena forming a vivid backdrop to the chaos. Each encounter challenges you with hordes of enemy plasma forms, leading to an epic boss battle where you recover a portion of your lost power. With every victory, you unlock upgrades and power-ups, many of which are fragments of your stolen essence—making you stronger, faster, and more devastating than before.

The cycle of destruction and growth is at the core of your mission. As you recover your scattered particles, new abilities and enhancements allow you to unleash even greater force against the enemy. But beware—the adversary who stole your essence grows ever more dangerous, and each confrontation is a test of both skill and survival.

Features:

  • Fast-paced side-scrolling destruction across dynamic space environments

  • Unique plasma-based characters—from your playable hero to your enemies

  • Epic boss fights after every level, each granting you fragments of your lost essence

  • Upgrade system, allowing you to evolve and regain stolen powers

  • Stunning cosmic backdrops filled with planets, asteroids, and interstellar debris

  • A story of resilience and revenge as you battle to become whole again

Do you have the power to take back every particle of your being, or will you be lost to the void forever?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3000 series / Intel Core i5-10400F
  • Graphics: AMD RX Vega 64 / Nvidia GTX 1080
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 5800X / Intel Core i7-11700K
  • Graphics: Radeon RX 6800 / Nvidia RTX 3070
